allthemodium.name: Allthemodium
allthemodium.guide:
Allthemodium, then Vibranium, then Unobtainium: the three metals that pace ATM10's late game. Each gear tier needs a smithing template, and each template comes from a different place.
Checked against: Allthemodium 3.2.1 (branche 1.21.x) + scripts KubeJS et livre de quêtes d'ATM10

## Where to find the templates
- Allthemodium template: brush Suspicious Clay in the floors of Ancient Cities. The block always gives it.
- Vibranium template: brush Suspicious Soul Sand in Nether Bastions. Also a 100% drop.
- Unobtainium template: no archaeology. It comes from the Trial Spawners in the Dungeon's library rooms, in The Other dimension.
- With Lootr, suspicious blocks give their loot to each player, like chests.
Sources: loot_table/arch.json, arch2.json, chest/template.json (https://github.com/AllTheMods/Allthemodium/tree/1.21.x/src/main/resources/data/allthemodium/loot_table); ATM10 quêtes : chapitre Allthemodium (https://github.com/AllTheMods/ATM-10/blob/main/config/ftbquests/quests/lang/en_us/chapters/allthemodium.snbt)

## Duplicating a template
Once you've found the first template, you never need to look again: each one copies at the crafting table, 1 makes 2. Each has its own recipe.
1. Allthemodium template: 1 template + 7 netherite ingots + 1 deepslate -> 2 templates
2. Vibranium template: 1 template + 7 Allthemodium ingots + 1 Ancient Stone -> 2 templates
3. Unobtainium template: 1 template + 7 Vibranium ingots + 1 end stone -> 2 templates
Sources: recipe/smithing/*_upgrade_smithing_template.json (https://github.com/AllTheMods/Allthemodium/tree/1.21.x/src/main/resources/data/allthemodium/recipe/smithing)

## Upgrade order
- Netherite → Allthemodium: netherite tool + Allthemodium template + Allthemodium ingot, at the smithing table.
- Allthemodium → Vibranium: Allthemodium tool + Vibranium template + Vibranium ingot.
- Vibranium → Unobtainium: Vibranium tool + Unobtainium template + Unobtainium ingot.
- ATM10 also adds "silent plates" that use the same templates (plate + template + previous tier's ingot).
Sources: recipe/smithing/*_pickaxe_smithing.json (https://github.com/AllTheMods/Allthemodium/tree/1.21.x/src/main/resources/data/allthemodium/recipe/smithing); ATM10 kubejs/.../Allthemodium/Recipes.js (https://github.com/AllTheMods/ATM-10/blob/main/kubejs/server_scripts/mods/Allthemodium/Recipes.js)

- "Awakened" alloy block (also at the Star Altar): 1 Unobtainium-Vibranium alloy block + 4 Awakened Supremium Essence + 4 Awakened Supremium Gemstones + 4 Unbreaking I books.
- Patrick Star: 13 magenta concrete, 11 pink concrete, 8 green concrete, 8 green concrete powder, 8 magenta concrete powder, 5 pink concrete powder and 2 lime concrete. There's also a Create Mechanical Crafter recipe.

## The shard route
1. Fragments 1 to 5 (Star Altar): 48 ATM Star Shards + Soul Binding Crystal (fragment 1); 52 shards + a prism for the others: Whirlwind, Smelter, Sea, Terrastomp -> 1 fragment each
2. Infused Patrick Star (Star Altar): 36 shards + 12 Infused Breath + 4 Mending I books + the 3 alloy ingots + Patrick Star -> Infused Patrick Star
3. ATM Star (Star Altar): the 5 fragments + Lens of the Killer + Mundabitur Dust + Corrupti Dust + Infused Patrick Star -> 1 ATM Star

ae2.name: Applied Energistics 2
ae2.guide:
AE2 is the most powerful storage in the pack, and the most demanding: everything revolves around channels. Once you know how many each cable carries, the rest follows.
Checked against: Applied Energistics 2 19.2.18 + config/ae2-common.toml d'ATM10

## Channels
Almost every device on the network (terminal, interface, bus, drive…) uses one channel. ATM10 keeps AE2's default channel mode.
- Normal cable (glass, covered, smart): 8 channels.
- Dense cable: 32 channels. Each controller face provides 32.
- Without a controller a network still works, but with 8 devices at most.
- Rule of thumb: dense cable out of the controller, then normal cable for groups of 8 machines.
Sources: GridNode.getMaxChannels (https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/blob/neoforge/v19.2.18/src/main/java/appeng/me/GridNode.java); ChannelMode.java (https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/blob/neoforge/v19.2.18/src/main/java/appeng/api/networking/pathing/ChannelMode.java); ATM10 config/ae2-common.toml (https://github.com/AllTheMods/ATM-10/blob/main/config/ae2-common.toml)

## The controller
- Several controller blocks touching form one controller. The structure can't exceed 7 blocks on any axis.
- All controller blocks on the network must touch each other, otherwise the network goes into conflict.
- No crosses: if a block has controllers on both sides along two axes at once (say north-south and east-west), the network goes into conflict. Lines, slabs and corners are fine.
Sources: ControllerValidator.java (https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/blob/neoforge/v19.2.18/src/main/java/appeng/me/pathfinding/ControllerValidator.java)

## Storage cells
A cell has two limits: bytes and number of types. Each new type costs bytes before storing anything, so a cell full of 63 different items holds far less than you'd think.
- 1k = 1024 bytes, 4k = 4096, 16k = 16,384, 64k = 65,536, 256k = 262,144.
- 1 byte = 8 items, or 8 buckets for fluids.
- Item cells: 63 types max. Fluid cells: 18 types max.
- Cost per type: 8 bytes (1k), 32 (4k), 128 (16k), 512 (64k), 2048 (256k). Example: a 1k with a single type holds (1024 − 8) × 8 = 8128 items.
Sources: AEItems.java (https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/blob/neoforge/v19.2.18/src/main/java/appeng/core/definitions/AEItems.java); StorageTier.java (https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/blob/neoforge/v19.2.18/src/main/java/appeng/items/storage/StorageTier.java); AEKeyType.getAmountPerByte (https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/blob/neoforge/v19.2.18/src/main/java/appeng/api/stacks/AEKeyType.java)

## The crafting CPU
- A solid box (no gaps) of crafting blocks: Crafting Units, Crafting Storage, Co-Processing Units, Crafting Monitors.
- At least one Crafting Storage, otherwise the CPU won't form.
- 17 blocks at most on each axis.
Sources: CraftingCPUCalculator.java (https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/blob/neoforge/v19.2.18/src/main/java/appeng/me/cluster/implementations/CraftingCPUCalculator.java)

ars_nouveau.name: Ars Nouveau
ars_nouveau.guide:
Ars Nouveau revolves around Source, the mod's magic energy. Most stalls come from a machine that can't find its pedestals or its Source: each machine has its own range.
Checked against: Ars Nouveau, branche 1.21.x (pack : 5.13.3) + config/ars_nouveau-common.toml d'ATM10

## Source
- A Source Jar holds 10,000 Source.
- Machines draw from nearby jars; distance is counted as x + y + z steps, not a straight line.
- In ATM10 you don't spawn with the book: you have to craft it.
Sources: SourceJarTile.java (https://github.com/baileyholl/Ars-Nouveau/blob/1.21.x/src/main/java/com/hollingsworth/arsnouveau/common/block/tile/SourceJarTile.java); SourceUtil.java (https://github.com/baileyholl/Ars-Nouveau/blob/1.21.x/src/main/java/com/hollingsworth/arsnouveau/api/util/SourceUtil.java); ATM10 config/ars_nouveau-common.toml (https://github.com/AllTheMods/ATM-10/blob/main/config/ars_nouveau-common.toml)

## The Enchanting Apparatus
- Arcane Pedestals must sit in a 7 × 7 × 7 cube centred on the apparatus (3 blocks in every direction, up and down included).
- Source comes from jars within 10 blocks.
Sources: EnchantingApparatusTile.java (https://github.com/baileyholl/Ars-Nouveau/blob/1.21.x/src/main/java/com/hollingsworth/arsnouveau/common/block/tile/EnchantingApparatusTile.java); IPedestalMachine.pedestalList (https://github.com/baileyholl/Ars-Nouveau/tree/1.21.x/src/main/java/com/hollingsworth/arsnouveau)

## The Imbuement Chamber
- Its pedestals must touch it: a 3 × 3 × 3 cube around it.
- It pulls Source from jars within 2 blocks, 200 at a time every second.
- With no jar in range it still works, just very slowly: 10 Source per second.
Sources: ImbuementTile.java (https://github.com/baileyholl/Ars-Nouveau/blob/1.21.x/src/main/java/com/hollingsworth/arsnouveau/common/block/tile/ImbuementTile.java)

enderio.name: Ender IO
enderio.guide:
Ender IO is mostly about its alloys, conduits and a few unique machines. Beware of old guides: version 8 removed some alloys and changed recipes.
Checked against: Ender IO 8.2.12-beta + scripts KubeJS d'ATM10

## Alloys (Alloy Smelter)
Electrical Steel no longer exists in Ender IO 8. ATM10 adds SAG Mill recipes for ores, raw ores and ingots that had none.
1. Conductive Alloy: iron + copper -> 2 ingots
2. Redstone Alloy: redstone + copper -> 1 ingot
3. Pulsating Alloy: iron + ender pearl -> 2 ingots
4. Energetic Alloy: redstone + Conductive Alloy + gold -> 2 ingots
5. Vibrant Alloy: Energetic Alloy + ender pearl + glowstone -> 2 ingots
6. Dark Steel: iron + coal dust + obsidian -> 2 ingots
7. End Steel: end stone + Dark Steel + obsidian -> 2 ingots
8. Soularium: soul sand or soul soil + gold -> 1 ingot
Sources: recipe/alloy_smelting/*.json (https://github.com/Team-EnderIO/EnderIO/tree/v8.2.12-beta/enderio/src/generated/resources/data/enderio/recipe/alloy_smelting); ATM10 kubejs/.../EnderIO/Recipes.js (https://github.com/AllTheMods/ATM-10/blob/main/kubejs/server_scripts/mods/EnderIO/Recipes.js)

## The pack's two "Enchanters"
ATM10 has two blocks called Enchanter, and they do completely different things.
- Ender IO's Enchanter: makes an enchanted book. It takes a book and quill (not a plain book), lapis and an item specific to the enchantment (a lily pad for Aqua Affinity, say), and costs XP levels.
- Mystical Agriculture's Enchanter: enchants the item you put in directly, using ingredients and Experience Essence (Sharpness: 16 quartz + 64 Experience Essence).
Sources: Ender IO EnchanterBlockEntity / EnchanterRecipe (https://github.com/Team-EnderIO/EnderIO/tree/v8.2.12-beta/enderio/src/main/java/com/enderio/enderio/content/enchanter); Ender IO recipe/enchanting/aqua_affinity.json (https://github.com/Team-EnderIO/EnderIO/blob/v8.2.12-beta/enderio/src/generated/resources/data/enderio/recipe/enchanting/aqua_affinity.json); Mystical Agriculture recipe/enchanter/sharpness.json (https://github.com/BlakeBr0/MysticalAgriculture/blob/1.21/src/main/resources/data/mysticalagriculture/recipe/enchanter/sharpness.json)

bigreactors.name: Extreme Reactors
bigreactors.guide:
Extreme Reactors is the classic build-it-any-size reactor, and ATM10 makes it very profitable. Its build rules differ from Mekanism's, which is where people go wrong.
Checked against: Extreme Reactors 2.4.27 (code) + config/extremereactors/common.toml d'ATM10 (pack : 2.4.28)

## ATM10 settings
- Power output ×4 for the whole mod, then another ×3 for the reactor and ×3 for the turbine.
- Fuel usage ×0.8.
- Reinforced reactor: up to 32 blocks wide and 48 high. Reinforced turbine: 32 × 32.
- Basic versions are capped: 5-block reactor, turbine 5 wide and 10 high.

- You need at least one controller and at least one control rod.
- All control rods on the same face. Behind each one, a straight line of Fuel Rods across the reactor, ending on a Reactor Casing (not glass).
- No loose Fuel Rods: each one must belong to a column behind a control rod.
- The rest of the inside: air or moderators (blocks and fluids the mod recognises).

forbidden_arcanus.name: Forbidden Arcanus
forbidden_arcanus.guide:
In ATM10, Forbidden & Arcanus matters mostly for its Hephaestus Forge: it makes the Runic Star Altar controller, and so the road to the ATM Star. You need to take it to tier 5.
Checked against: Forbidden & Arcanus, branche 1.21.1 (pack : 2.6.1) + scripts KubeJS d'ATM10

## The forge's 5 tiers
Each tier raises the maximum stock of the four essences (aureal, souls, blood, experience). A ritual that needs more than that stock can't start.
- Tier 1: 1000 aureal, 10 souls, 10,000 blood, 900 XP.
- Tier 2: 3000 aureal, 50 souls, 15,000 blood, 1350 XP.
- Tier 3: 5000 aureal, 100 souls, 30,000 blood, 2500 XP.
- Tier 4: 10,000 aureal, 500 souls, 50,000 blood, 5000 XP.
- Tier 5: 20,000 aureal, 1000 souls, 100,000 blood, 7500 XP.
Sources: HephaestusForgeLevel.java (https://github.com/stal111/Forbidden-Arcanus/blob/1.21.1/neoforge/src/main/java/com/stal111/forbidden_arcanus/common/block/entity/forge/HephaestusForgeLevel.java)

## Upgrading the forge
Each upgrade is itself a forge ritual: a main item in the forge, ingredients on the pedestals, and essences.
1. To tier 2: Edelwood planks + 4 Arcane Crystals + 4 Spawner Scraps; 500 aureal, 6000 blood, 10 souls -> tier 2 forge
2. To tier 3: chiseled polished darkstone + 4 Arcane Crystals + 4 Deorum ingots; 1000 aureal, 9000 blood, 50 souls -> tier 3 forge
3. To tier 4: chiseled polished darkstone + 4 Stellarite Pieces + 4 Runes; 2000 aureal, 12,000 blood, 100 souls -> tier 4 forge
4. To tier 5: Stellarite block + 4 Sculk Catalysts + 2 Dark Nether Stars + 2 Dragon Scales; 5000 aureal, 20,000 blood, 500 souls -> tier 5 forge
Sources: hephaestus_forge/ritual/upgrade_tier_*.json (https://github.com/stal111/Forbidden-Arcanus/tree/1.21.1/neoforge/src/generated/resources/data/forbidden_arcanus/forbidden_arcanus/hephaestus_forge/ritual)

## Duplicating relics (ATM10)
The Star Altar ritual needs 4 enhancers. ATM10 adds rituals to copy relics: the relic in the forge, 4 Obsidiansteel blocks and 4 ingots on the pedestals, tier 3 forge, 1000 aureal, 1000 blood, 100 souls and 100 XP. You get 2 relics back.
- Artisan Relic: Deorum ingots.
- Elementarium: Allthemodium ingots.
- Crimson Stone: Vibranium ingots.
- Divine Pact: Unobtainium ingots.
Sources: ATM10 kubejs/.../ForbiddenArcanus/Hephaestus_Forge.js (https://github.com/AllTheMods/ATM-10/blob/main/kubejs/server_scripts/mods/ForbiddenArcanus/Hephaestus_Forge.js)

industrialforegoing.name: Industrial Foregoing
industrialforegoing.guide:
Industrial Foregoing automates farms, mobs and ores. Everything starts with plastic, and plastic starts with latex from trees.
Checked against: Industrial Foregoing, branche 1.21 (pack : 3.6.39)

## From latex to plastic
Latex is slow: place several Fluid Extractors around a tree farm rather than just one.
1. Fluid Extractor (facing a log): 1 oak log -> 2 mB latex per operation (1% chance to strip the log)
2. Latex Processing Unit: 750 mB latex + 500 mB water -> 1 Dry Rubber
3. Furnace: 1 Dry Rubber -> 1 Plastic
Sources: recipe/fluid_extractor/oak.json (https://github.com/InnovativeOnlineIndustries/Industrial-Foregoing/blob/1.21/src/generated/resources/data/industrialforegoing/recipe/fluid_extractor/oak.json); LatexProcessingUnitTile.java (https://github.com/InnovativeOnlineIndustries/Industrial-Foregoing/blob/1.21/src/main/java/com/buuz135/industrial/block/core/tile/LatexProcessingUnitTile.java); recipe/plastic.json (https://github.com/InnovativeOnlineIndustries/Industrial-Foregoing/blob/1.21/src/generated/resources/data/industrialforegoing/recipe/plastic.json)

## Machine frames
- The Simple Machine Frame is made in the Dissolution Chamber: 2 plastic, a Pity Machine Frame, 2 nether bricks, 2 iron ingots and a gold gear, with 250 mB latex.
- Advanced and Supreme frames also go through the Dissolution Chamber: check their recipe in JEI/EMI.
- Pink Slime Ingot: 2 iron + 2 gold ingots + 1000 mB pink slime, in the Dissolution Chamber.
Sources: dissolution_chamber/simple_machine_frame.json (https://github.com/InnovativeOnlineIndustries/Industrial-Foregoing/blob/1.21/src/generated/resources/data/industrialforegoing/recipe/dissolution_chamber/simple_machine_frame.json); dissolution_chamber/pink_slime_ingot.json (https://github.com/InnovativeOnlineIndustries/Industrial-Foregoing/blob/1.21/src/generated/resources/data/industrialforegoing/recipe/dissolution_chamber/pink_slime_ingot.json)

## The laser drill
- One Ore Laser Base (or Fluid Laser Base) and Laser Drills facing it, about 2 blocks away.
- Each powered Laser Drill pushes the base's progress bar: the more drills, the faster it mines.
- The base has 6 slots for coloured lenses to favour certain ores. Mining depth is shown in its interface.
Sources: LaserDrillTile.java (https://github.com/InnovativeOnlineIndustries/Industrial-Foregoing/blob/1.21/src/main/java/com/buuz135/industrial/block/resourceproduction/tile/LaserDrillTile.java); OreLaserBaseTile.java (https://github.com/InnovativeOnlineIndustries/Industrial-Foregoing/blob/1.21/src/main/java/com/buuz135/industrial/block/resourceproduction/tile/OreLaserBaseTile.java)

mekanism.name: Mekanism
mekanism.guide:
Mekanism is the mod everyone ends up building in ATM10: ore processing, reactors, then the MekaSuit. Multiblocks are where people get stuck, because the game only says "invalid structure". Here are the exact rules, read from the code that checks the structures, with a minimal working schematic for each.
Checked against: Mekanism 10.7.19 + config et scripts KubeJS d'ATM10 (branche main)

## Uranium chain to fissile fuel
The fission reactor burns fissile fuel. It takes six steps, all in regular Mekanism machines.
1. Enrichment Chamber: 1 uranium ingot -> 2 Yellow Cake Uranium
2. Chemical Oxidizer: 1 Yellow Cake Uranium -> 250 mB Uranium Oxide
3. Chemical Oxidizer, then Chemical Infuser ×2: sulfur dust → sulfur dioxide; + oxygen → trioxide; + water vapor -> Sulfuric Acid
4. Chemical Dissolution Chamber: 1 fluorite gem + sulfuric acid (used up every tick) -> 1000 mB Hydrofluoric Acid
5. Chemical Infuser: 1 Hydrofluoric Acid + 1 Uranium Oxide -> 2 Uranium Hexafluoride
6. Isotopic Centrifuge: 1 Uranium Hexafluoride -> 1 Fissile Fuel
Sources: Mekanism: recipe/processing/uranium/*.json (https://github.com/mekanism/Mekanism/tree/v1.21.1-10.7.19.85/src/datagen/generated/mekanism/data/mekanism/recipe/processing/uranium)

## Fission reactor
The reactor heats water (or sodium) into steam, which you then send into a turbine. It doesn't make power on its own.
- Size: any box from 3×3×3 to 18×18×18.
- Edges: Fission Reactor Casing only. Faces: casing, glass, ports or logic adapter.
- Inside: air, Fission Fuel Assemblies and Control Rod Assemblies, nothing else.
- Each column of fuel assemblies must be unbroken, with exactly one control rod right on top. At least one column is required.
- Each assembly burns at most 1 mB/t and stores 8000 mB of fuel (ATM10 config).
- Above 1200 K the reactor takes damage. At 100% damage it can blow up: meltdowns are enabled in ATM10, with an 8-block radius.
- Set the ports with the Configurator: fuel and coolant in, heated coolant out, waste out.

This is what turns steam from the reactor or boiler into power. The order of the layers matters.
- Size: from 5×3×5 to 17×18×17. Length and width must be odd.
- The Rotational Complex goes in the centre column. Below it, an unbroken stack of rotors down to the floor.
- At the complex's level, a full layer of Pressure Dispersers fills the whole inside.
- Electromagnetic Coils go above the complex and must connect to it (directly or coil to coil). Condensers too, above only.
- Turbine Vents are not allowed below the complex's level.
- You need 1 coil per 8 blades (ATM10 config), at most 2 blades per rotor and 28 blades in total.

1. Solar Neutron Activator: 5 mB Nuclear Waste -> 1 mB Polonium
2. Isotopic Centrifuge: 5 mB Nuclear Waste -> 1 mB Plutonium

- Each face's outline is SPS Casing; the face centres take casing or SPS Ports.
- Supercharged Coils go inside, right behind a port. A coil that doesn't touch a port breaks the structure.

mekanismgenerators.name: Mekanism: Generators
mekanismgenerators.guide:
Mekanism is the mod everyone ends up building in ATM10: ore processing, reactors, then the MekaSuit. Multiblocks are where people get stuck, because the game only says "invalid structure". Here are the exact rules, read from the code that checks the structures, with a minimal working schematic for each.
Checked against: Mekanism 10.7.19 + config et scripts KubeJS d'ATM10 (branche main)

## Uranium chain to fissile fuel
The fission reactor burns fissile fuel. It takes six steps, all in regular Mekanism machines.
1. Enrichment Chamber: 1 uranium ingot -> 2 Yellow Cake Uranium
2. Chemical Oxidizer: 1 Yellow Cake Uranium -> 250 mB Uranium Oxide
3. Chemical Oxidizer, then Chemical Infuser ×2: sulfur dust → sulfur dioxide; + oxygen → trioxide; + water vapor -> Sulfuric Acid
4. Chemical Dissolution Chamber: 1 fluorite gem + sulfuric acid (used up every tick) -> 1000 mB Hydrofluoric Acid
5. Chemical Infuser: 1 Hydrofluoric Acid + 1 Uranium Oxide -> 2 Uranium Hexafluoride
6. Isotopic Centrifuge: 1 Uranium Hexafluoride -> 1 Fissile Fuel
Sources: Mekanism: recipe/processing/uranium/*.json (https://github.com/mekanism/Mekanism/tree/v1.21.1-10.7.19.85/src/datagen/generated/mekanism/data/mekanism/recipe/processing/uranium)

## Fission reactor
The reactor heats water (or sodium) into steam, which you then send into a turbine. It doesn't make power on its own.
- Size: any box from 3×3×3 to 18×18×18.
- Edges: Fission Reactor Casing only. Faces: casing, glass, ports or logic adapter.
- Inside: air, Fission Fuel Assemblies and Control Rod Assemblies, nothing else.
- Each column of fuel assemblies must be unbroken, with exactly one control rod right on top. At least one column is required.
- Each assembly burns at most 1 mB/t and stores 8000 mB of fuel (ATM10 config).
- Above 1200 K the reactor takes damage. At 100% damage it can blow up: meltdowns are enabled in ATM10, with an 8-block radius.
- Set the ports with the Configurator: fuel and coolant in, heated coolant out, waste out.

mysticalagriculture.guide:
Mystical Agriculture grows resources. ATM10 changes several of its rules: seeds can only be made at the infusion altar, and the Allthemodium metals get their own tier, "Magical".
Checked against: Mystical Agriculture (branche 1.21 ; pack 8.0.28) + config, Mystical Customization et KubeJS d'ATM10

## Tiering up essence
1. Crafting table: 4 Inferium Essence in a plus + 1 Infusion Crystal in the middle -> 1 Prudentium Essence
2. Crafting table: same shape with 4 Prudentium -> 1 Tertium
3. Crafting table: then 4 Tertium → 1 Imperium, 4 Imperium → 1 Supremium -> Supremium Essence
- In ATM10 an Infusion Crystal lasts 500 uses. The Master Infusion Crystal never wears out.
- Mobs don't drop Inferium in ATM10: it comes from the ore and from seeds.
Sources: recipe/prudentium_essence.json (https://github.com/BlakeBr0/MysticalAgriculture/blob/1.21/src/main/resources/data/mysticalagriculture/recipe/prudentium_essence.json); ATM10 config/mysticalagriculture-common.toml (https://github.com/AllTheMods/ATM-10/blob/main/config/mysticalagriculture-common.toml)

## The infusion altar
- 8 Infusion Pedestals around the altar, at the same height: 3 blocks away in the 4 directions, and 2 blocks away on the diagonals.
- The centre item goes on the altar, the 8 ingredients on the pedestals. Start it with a redstone signal or a right-click with the Wand.
- In ATM10 it's the only way to make seeds: crafting-table seed recipes are turned off.

powah.name: Powah
powah.guide:
Powah is the simplest early power source: few multiblocks, lots of tiers. The reactor and the energizing orb are the two pieces to understand.
Checked against: Powah 6.2.10 + config/powah.json5 d'ATM10

## The reactor
- It's 3 × 3 wide and 4 high: 36 reactor blocks of the same tier.
- You need all 36 blocks in your inventory: place one and the reactor builds itself around it. The space must be clear.
- It burns uraninite. Without carbon, output is divided by 1.2; without redstone, by 1.4. Redstone also raises fuel use and heat.
- The hotter it runs, the less it makes. Liquid coolant: water. Solid coolant, from worst to best: snow, ice, packed ice, blue ice, then Powah's dry ice (−32).

## Output per tier (ATM10)
- Reactor: Starter 500, Basic 2000, Hardened 5000, Blazing 20,000, Niotic 50,000, Spirited 200,000, Nitro 500,000 FE/t.
- These are maximums: real output depends on heat and additives (carbon, redstone).
Sources: ATM10 config/powah.json5 (https://github.com/AllTheMods/ATM-10/blob/main/config/powah.json5)

## The energizing orb
- Energizing Rods link themselves to the nearest orb within 4 blocks (ATM10 config), whichever way they face.
- More rods = faster recipes. Each rod tier has its own rate: from 200 FE/t (Starter) to 400,000 FE/t (Nitro).
- ATM10 changes some energizing recipes through its scripts: check JEI/EMI rather than an old guide.
Sources: ATM10 config/powah.json5 (https://github.com/AllTheMods/ATM-10/blob/main/config/powah.json5); ATM10 kubejs/.../Powah/Energizing.js (https://github.com/AllTheMods/ATM-10/blob/main/kubejs/server_scripts/mods/Powah/Energizing.js); EnergizingRodBlock.setOrbPos (https://github.com/Technici4n/Powah/blob/v6.2.10/src/main/java/owmii/powah/block/energizing/EnergizingRodBlock.java)

refinedstorage.name: Refined Storage
refinedstorage.guide:
ATM10 ships Refined Storage 2, a full rewrite of the mod. Many guides online still describe version 1: disk sizes and autocrafting have changed.
Checked against: Refined Storage 2.0.9 + config/refinedstorage-common.toml d'ATM10

## How it differs from AE2
- No channels: plug in as many devices as you like on one cable.
- Cables use no energy (0 in ATM10). The controller stores 50,000 FE.
- Each device has its own draw: 10 FE/t for a Disk Drive plus 4 per disk, 14 for a Crafting Grid, 16 for a Wireless Transmitter (ATM10 values).
- The Wireless Transmitter reaches 16 blocks, +8 per Range Upgrade.
Sources: ATM10 config/refinedstorage-common.toml (https://github.com/AllTheMods/ATM-10/blob/main/config/refinedstorage-common.toml)

## Storage disks
Unlike AE2 there's no type limit: a 1k disk holds 1024 items, whether they're all the same or all different.
- Items: 1k = 1024, 4k = 4096, 16k = 16,384, 64k = 65,536 items.
- Fluids: 64, 256, 1024 and 4096 buckets.
- For bigger disks, ATM10 includes ExtraStorage.
Sources: ItemStorageVariant.java (https://github.com/refinedmods/refinedstorage2/blob/v2.0.9/refinedstorage-common/src/main/java/com/refinedmods/refinedstorage/common/storage/ItemStorageVariant.java); FluidStorageVariant.java (https://github.com/refinedmods/refinedstorage2/blob/v2.0.9/refinedstorage-common/src/main/java/com/refinedmods/refinedstorage/common/storage/FluidStorageVariant.java)

## Autocrafting
- Make patterns in the Pattern Grid and put them in an Autocrafter: 9 patterns per Autocrafter.
- Up to 8 Autocrafters can be chained one behind another so they share the same target machine.
Sources: AutocrafterBlockEntity.java (https://github.com/refinedmods/refinedstorage2/blob/v2.0.9/refinedstorage-common/src/main/java/com/refinedmods/refinedstorage/common/autocrafting/autocrafter/AutocrafterBlockEntity.java)
